risks.risk: Whether the machine is working properly (motor, speed control, stitching quality). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on with the foot pedal (or power switch) showing it running, plus a close-up of stitching on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service/doesn’t stitch).

risks.risk: Missing or non-matching accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet). Photos don’t show what’s included.
risks.proof: A clear photo list of included items laid out (power cable, foot pedal, needles, bobbins, presser feet) and a photo of the machine with the pedal connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as incomplete/no accessories included beyond the machine.

risks.risk: Model-specific parts compatibility (since the exact model number isn’t readable).
risks.proof: A photo of the machine’s rating/model plate (bottom or back) showing model number and voltage.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as generic/unknown model with potential parts-compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Mechanical issues not visible (timing, tension problems, broken internal parts).
risks.proof: Video showing correct thread tension and even stitches on at least two fabric types (e.g., cotton and denim).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as may require adjustment/repair.

proof_requests: Photo of the model/rating plate (bottom/back) with model number and voltage.
Video: power on + foot pedal running + stitching on fabric (close-up of stitch formation).
Photos of what’s included: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet, and any manual.
